ideas.pitch: A hyper-local volunteer driver and senior outing organizer specifically tailored for Mumbai local transit corridors to combat elder isolation.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual local-dialect AI voice assistant providing preventive healthcare and vaccination schedules tailored to urban slum communities in Mumbai.
